title: feat: support device cgroup rules via annotation in kube play
body:
Add support for device cgroup rules in podman kube play through the io.podman.annotations.device-cgroup-rule/<container-name> annotation.

The annotation accepts comma-separated device cgroup rules following the existing parser format: "type major:minor access" (e.g., "c 9:* rwm"). Rules are container-specific and only apply to the matching container.

This enables workloads that need access to device classes (e.g., tape drives with char major 9) without requiring privileged mode or specific device paths at pod start time.

Changes:
- Add DeviceCgroupRuleAnnotation constant
- Parse annotation in ToSpecGen() using existing parser
- Export ParseLinuxResourcesDeviceAccess for reuse
- Add comprehensive tests for valid/invalid rules and container targeting

Fixes #30029
